 Share on Recruiters HOBIJ 21 July 2025 Meet our recruiters 
Thinking about moving to the Netherlands to give your career a boost? That's great news. At HOBIJ, we're here to support you every step of the way. And it always starts with the right contact. 
Every day, our recruiters help people from all over Europe start their new adventure abroad. They are friendly, honest, and clear. No hidden conditions, no strange promises. Just real people, helping real people. 
Here's who you might be talking to! 
 Zuzana Jansen-Bodo 
Zuzana is super experienced and speaks 7 languages. She can help you in Slovakian, Polish, Dutch, English, Czech, Hungarian, and even a bit of Spanish. "I love meeting people from all over Europe. If you are motivated, I will try to find a job for you. No worries." How she helps? Zuzana - or Zuza, for short - will explain everything about your contract, work, and housing. She will answer all your questions, big or small. 
"The only thing I ask? Be honest in your CV. We find out everything. We are a bit like detectives. " 
In her free time, she likes to travel, cook, and spend time with her dog Harvey. Tania Hagi 
Tania is based in Romania and supports candidates every day. She speaks Romanian and English and would love to learn Spanish and Greek one day. "What I like most about HOBIJ is how friendly and helpful everyone is. I felt welcome from the start." Her tip for new candidates? "Don't be embarrassed to ask questions. Nobody will judge you. " 
When she's not working, you will find her reading, writing, or going out with friends. Oana Radu 
Oana is also based in Romania and is the go-to person for all technical jobs within HOBIJ. "HOBIJ feels like one big family. You can always count on us." She helps people step by step, from your first interview to your first working day. She helps with documents and explains how life in the Netherlands works. 
Oana enjoys hiking or dancing with friends. recruitment ...

 Are you an experienced Structural Engineer who thrives on technically complex and highly visible projects? 
At ACE, you will work on unique, large-scale structures, ranging from innovative water slides and amusement rides delivered worldwide to other complex constructions across various industries, including emerging opportunities in the cruise industry. Based in the Eindhoven region, you will be part of international project teams and closely involved throughout the entire process, from concept design to execution. In this role, you combine in-depth structural expertise with practical feasibility and directly contribute to projects that must perform reliably under challenging conditions. WHAT WILL YOU DO? 
As a Structural Engineer based in the Eindhoven region, you will work within an international team, performing structural calculations and analyses for large-scale constructions across various industries. 
This includes support structures for water slides and amusement rides in the attractions industry, as well as an increasing number of structures for the cruise and maritime sector. You will design, calculate and detail structures that need to perform reliably under demanding conditions. 
You will be involved throughout the full process, from initial concept to final delivery. Together with fellow engineers, you will develop smart, feasible solutions that are technically robust and practical to realise. Your responsibilities include: - Setting up FEM cal...

Are you looking for an opportunity to work in a high-tech pharmaceutical environment and contribute to products that can make a real difference to patients worldwide? For Lonza in Geleen, we are looking for motivated professionals for two exciting positions: Biotech Associate and Cleanroom Production Operator. Lonza is a global leader in life sciences, working on innovative solutions that support the development and production of medicines and therapies. At the Geleen site, you will become part of a professional GMP environment where quality, safety, teamwork and continuous improvement are central. Whether you already have experience in biotechnology or are looking to build your career in a regulated production environment, both positions offer opportunities to learn, develop and grow within Lonza. Biotech Associate You bring: A completed MBO, HBO or Bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Life Sciences, Laboratory Technology or a related field. Preferably at least 2 years of experience in a GMP or cleanroom environment. A precise and quality-driven way of working. The ability to work according to detailed procedures and documentation requirements. Strong communication and teamwork skills. Good written and spoken English. Flexibility to work shifts, including evenings and weekends. A valid driving licence, as public transport is limited during some shifts. Cleanroom Production Operator You bring: MBO-level education or equivalent work and thinking level, preferably in a technical, production, logistics or scientific field. Experience in production, logistics, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, cleanrooms or another regulated environment is an advantage. A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail. A responsible approach to quality, safety and following procedures. communication and teamwork skills. The flexibility to switch between tasks and priorities when required. A willingness to learn and develop within GMP manufacturing. Good written and spoken

English. Biotech Associate Gross salary: €2,800 – €3,800 per month, depending on your knowledge, experience and added value. In addition: Direct employment contract with Lonza. Mileage allowance. Performance-based bonus plan. Extensive training and development opportunities. Clear career opportunities within Lonza. A professional and collaborative GMP working environment. Cleanroom Production Operator Gross salary: €2,600 – €3,500 per month, depending on your knowledge and experience. In addition: Mileage allowance. Performance-based bonus plan. On-the-job training. Opportunities for professional development and career progression. A structured and professional GMP working environment. Collaboration with different teams across the production organization. The opportunity to build valuable experience in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry. A workplace where safety, quality and teamwork are highly valued. Your next step in life sciences starts at Lonza. Whether you bring hands-on biotech experience or are ready to develop your career in cleanroom production, these roles offer the opportunity to learn, grow and contribute to work that matters. Biotech Associate As a Biotech Associate, you will be part of a specialized production team working on advanced cell therapy processes. You will perform a range of hands-on activities in a GMP cleanroom and ensure that production is carried out safely, accurately and according to established procedures. Your main responsibilities include: Performing cell and tissue culture activities in accordance with GMP requirements. Supporting processes such as media preparation, cell expansion and harvesting. Working with aseptic techniques in a controlled cleanroom environment. Recording production activities accurately in batch documentation. Identifying and reporting deviations or quality-related issues. Supporting continuous improvement within the production process. Working closely with colleagues from Manufacturing,

Are you looking for a logistics position within an innovative high-tech environment? Do you enjoy working in a structured and modern workplace where logistics and technology come together? Then this opportunity as a High-Tech Logistics Operator could be the perfect fit for you. What’s your job about? As a High-Tech Logistics Operator, you play an important role in ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products throughout the organization. Your work directly supports production processes and helps maintain operational efficiency. Your responsibilities include: Packing and preparing products for shipment. Processing and preparing outgoing orders. Transporting materials and goods within the warehouse and production areas. Working with logistics systems such as SAP. Monitoring the flow of goods and reporting discrepancies. Ensuring materials are available on time for production. Contributing to continuous improvements within logistics processes. This role goes beyond traditional warehouse activities. You are an essential link between logistics and production, helping to ensure that operations run efficiently and without interruptions. What skills do you have? A hands-on and proactive attitude. Accuracy and attention to detail. Motivation to learn and develop within a logistics environment. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Good communication skills in English. Previous logistics or warehouse experience is an advantage, but not required. Certificates such as EPT, forklift, or reach truck are considered a plus. What do you get in return? A gross salary of €19.17 per hour, including shift allowance. Travel allowance. A modern, clean, and high-tech working environment. Opportunities for personal development and career growth. A dynamic and motivated international team. Pension scheme participation. Holiday allowance and vacation days in accordance with Dutch regulations. You will join an international high-tech organization specializing in the

development and production of advanced technologies for industries such as industrial automation, energy, and healthcare. The company is known for its innovative culture, modern facilities, and strong focus on quality, collaboration, and employee development. Within this organization, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop new skills, and contribute to cutting-edge technologies used around the world.
